title: Mrs. Dalloway

vibeProfile.oneLine: One June day in London holds a whole life and its griefs.

summary: On a single June day in London, Clarissa Dalloway prepares to give a party, while across the city a shell-shocked veteran named Septimus moves toward tragedy, their lives never quite touching. Woolf's luminous novel flows through her characters' memories and inner lives in a continuous stream of consciousness, capturing how the whole of a person can live inside an ordinary hour. Radiant, sorrowful and formally daring, it is her most beloved and accessible masterpiece.
whyReadIt: Woolf's most radiant and accessible novel, a whole life inside one London day. Beautiful and quietly heartbreaking.

funFacts.text: Woolf's working title for the novel was 'The Hours', later borrowed for a novel and film about her.
